$description: Design tokens for @benchside/scaffold, in DTCG format.

50.$description: Lightest neutral — page background.

100.$description: Very light neutral — subtle section backgrounds, zebra rows.

200.$description: Light neutral — card and panel backgrounds, subtle dividers.

300.$description: Soft neutral — standard borders, disabled backgrounds.

400.$description: Muted neutral — placeholder and disabled text.

500.$description: Mid neutral — secondary text, default icon color.

600.$description: Deeper neutral — emphasized borders, secondary UI elements.

700.$description: Strong neutral — body text on light surfaces.

800.$description: Dark neutral — primary body text.

900.$description: Very dark neutral — headings, high-emphasis text.

950.$description: Darkest neutral — maximum-contrast text, dark-mode base surface.

cool-gray.$description: Custom neutral scale — hue 240, chroma 0.006–0.012. Faintly blue-tinted, precise without being cold. Chroma peaks at step 500, mirroring the curve shape used by every other color family.

50.$description: Lightest tint — info banner backgrounds, subtle selected-row fill.

100.$description: Very light tint — hover backgrounds on accent-adjacent surfaces.

200.$description: Light tint — accent-tinted borders, badges.

400.$description: Muted-vivid accent — hover state approaching default.

500.$description: Reference brand shade — default primary action color (buttons, links, active states). Lightness is tuned so text-inverse on a solid accent-default fill clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast; 400 and 600 are shifted by the same amount to keep step spacing even.

600.$description: Hover/active state for the default accent.

700.$description: Pressed/active accent, accent text on light surfaces.

800.$description: Dark accent — high-emphasis accent text.

900.$description: Very dark accent — dark-mode accent surfaces.

blue.$description: Custom primary accent — hue 250, chroma 0.020–0.190. Balanced between muted and vivid; the ecosystem default accent for tools that don't have their own signature color. Chroma peaks at step 500, the reference brand shade.

50.$description: Lightest step — tinted backgrounds, subtle fills.

100.$description: Very light step — hover backgrounds, subtle emphasis.

200.$description: Light step — borders, badges, light surfaces.

400.$description: Muted-vivid step — hover states approaching the reference shade.

500.$description: Reference step — the family's flagship shade, and the Calc theme's accent-default. Lightness is tuned so text-inverse on a solid accent-default fill clears WCAG AA 4.5:1 contrast; 400 and 600 are shifted by the same amount to keep step spacing even.

600.$description: Deeper step — hover/active state for the reference shade.

700.$description: Strong step — pressed state, accent text on light surfaces.

800.$description: Dark step — high-emphasis text or icons.

50.$description: 50px.

9999.$description: 9999px — effectively infinite; used for fully-rounded elements (radius.full).

size.$description: Generic dimension scale in px, matching the granularity of a classic 4px/0.25rem-multiplier spacing scale. Primitive only — no semantics attached (spacing, padding, margin, gap, etc. are assigned by the semantic layer).

sm.$description: 2px — subtle rounding for small controls (checkboxes, badges).

md.$description: 4px — default rounding for buttons and inputs.

sans.$description: Default UI typeface. 'Inter Variable' is the self-hosted @fontsource-variable/inter family name (see theme-default's fonts.css); 'Inter' is a secondary fallback for a system-installed static copy before dropping to platform sans-serifs.

mono.$description: Monospace typeface for numeric/code display — numeric readability is critical for scientific tools. 'JetBrains Mono Variable' is the self-hosted @fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono family name (see theme-default's fonts.css); 'JetBrains Mono' is a secondary fallback for a system-installed static copy.

size.$description: Type scale, in rem (respects user browser font-size preference, unlike px-based spacing/radius).

weight.$description: Full 100–900 OpenType wght range. Inter and JetBrains Mono are both variable fonts, so every named step is free — no additional font files required.

thin.$description: Thinnest available weight — decorative use only, rarely legible at UI sizes.

extralight.$description: Very light weight — large display text only.

light.$description: Light weight — large headings where a lighter feel is wanted.

black.$description: Maximum weight — sparingly, large display use.

letterSpacing.$description: Unitless letter-spacing values, interpreted as em in the CSS build (e.g. 0.05 => 0.05em). Stored as plain numbers because DTCG dimension tokens only support px/rem units, not em.

tight.$description: Large headings — tightened for optical balance.

wide.$description: All-caps labels and small text needing extra spacing.
